wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.gloss: a question or a puzzle to begin
wayIn.what: Begin at the threshold: one sideways question, about a door, a stone or a mark, opens a puzzle that suits the reading. Or step into any world below.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: see where an answer can take you
wayIn.what: See where each reading leads, then follow the world it opens onto, or any world card below.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan every page in one pass, with one plain line on what to do first on each.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.gloss: put out lamps or arrange keepsakes
worlds.what: Keep a vigil in a dim room: put out lamps, swap four to six keepsakes into the order their clues describe, or compare changed and turned lamp views. Shelf hints explain why a keepsake belongs.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.gloss: order your stars by a shifting postcard
worlds.what: Read your own sky: order a postcard's shifting lights by depth, or overlay one of four skies and turn your lights to meet its rings; inspect individual lights to discover where a near miss fails.

worlds.name: the gravity well
worlds.gloss: cast a probe through a ring
worlds.what: Cast a probe past a well and through a ring, order moons by their orbits, or find when two circling moons next meet and count the laps. Tap the picture to inspect a moon or a flight.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.gloss: recall your stars in flash order
worlds.what: Keep the watch: recall stars in flash order, find the two or three false logbook lines, or compare two skies. A fixed reference helps separate a shifted telescope from a star that really moved.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.gloss: order stars by their returning echoes
worlds.what: Read what answers: order stars by when their echoes return, or unmix four or five voices by comparing your selection with its beat totals.

worlds.name: the pulse loom
worlds.gloss: weave two beats and count where they cross
worlds.what: Weave two beats on one loop and count where they cross, say which way a strobed wheel seems to turn, or find the one dropped knot in a knotted round.

worlds.name: the pendulum hall
worlds.gloss: find when the pendulums cross
worlds.what: Keep time with pendulums: inspect their direction to find a shared crossing, or run a spring pair and tune where its swing crosses.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.gloss: order lanterns from clues
worlds.what: Light the rite: order lanterns from clues, predict a drift, recover missing winds, or follow mirrored lanterns to their first crossing.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.gloss: judge watering rounds or recover stem ages
worlds.what: Tend what is under glass: decide which plants get water, forecast a second round as the soil changes, or recover stem ages from leaves and weeks at rest.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.gloss: trace wind between high and low pressure
worlds.what: Read the weather maps: try an arrival hour and watch your forecast move, past a ridge on some maps, or trace the wind from high pressure to low.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.gloss: count folds and find the weave's mirror
worlds.what: Close the pattern: count the folds of a weave and spot its mirror, or count the bands of a moire to find the hidden screen.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.gloss: discover the automaton's rule
worlds.what: Learn the automaton's rule, test it in a notebook and write the next rows, find the one cell that changed, or run a rule backward to restore a lost first row.

worlds.name: the light table
worlds.gloss: measure light through a slit
worlds.what: Light a lamp on purpose: measure slit spacing, find the brightest filter chain, or match two or three coloured lamps to a target. Inspect their readings and keep comparing after the solve.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.gloss: find a loaded plank's balance point
worlds.what: Set the floor in motion: call the domino gaps, find a loaded plank's balance point, or choose and place a hanging counterweight to make it balance.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.gloss: read the layers of a soil core
worlds.what: Read a soil core, blend two or three bags of earth, or follow a root through the layers; three-bag blends must match both sand and clay.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.gloss: make words from scrambled letters
worlds.what: Fire scrambled letters into a word, or climb a word ladder using a rack of words and decoys; some climbs take an extra step.

worlds.name: the cipher cabinet
worlds.gloss: crack a letter wheel to unlock a note
worlds.what: Unlock a note: count its commonest letters to crack the wheel that shifted it, find the route a turning key reads it by, or wind a strip back onto its rod; every note opened earns the house's reply. Tap the picture to inspect a detail.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.gloss: file impossible specimens by clues
worlds.what: File impossible specimens by their clues — some cabinets stand five drawers tall — spot the one that breaks the drawer's rule, or find the forged catalogue number. Tap the picture to inspect a detail.

worlds.name: the shadow theatre
worlds.gloss: match enlarged shadows to cutouts
worlds.what: Find the lamp from a shadow's size, or match four, six or eight enlarged, leaning shadows to their cutouts; some casts also hide turned-over cutouts.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.gloss: turn a letter wheel until stars spell a word
worlds.what: Ask the archive: try turns of a letter wheel until its stars read a word, find two true omens, or trace a star's route and add its light.

finePrint.name: privacy
finePrint.what: Read exactly what stays in your browser, what cookies can count, and how to take all of it back.

finePrint.name: terms
finePrint.what: Read the plain bargain: play freely, keep what you make, and expect no warranty.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: A wrong turn lands here, and the rite goes on: a puzzle opens, and every world is below.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: Get the same page list as XML, for a search engine to read.
